origin_lanes.SUBSHOCK: First post-eligibility Stage-116 provisional full CL/MCL alignment inside one complete 5x-to-under-10x attention episode.
origin_lanes.ORDINARY_VELOCITY_FRONT: No active shock owner; all five completed-minute slopes share one incumbent sign, the prior 30-minute velocity was not opposite that incumbent, and the current 30-minute velocity first becomes opposite. The provisional direction is opposite the incumbent slope sign.

event_identity.one_active_front: At most one front is active per contract. Later qualifying observations are path evidence, not duplicate treatments.
event_identity.start: The exact seconds authority/provisional-alignment record ID for shock lanes, or the unique finalized Stage-112 decision timestamp and source checkpoint ID for an ordinary lane.
event_identity.terminal: The first subsequent exact V18 RAW_TURN, contract reset/roll, or irrecoverable source gap. Stage-114 normalization alone does not terminate the slower phase front.
event_identity.acceptance: A V18 raw turn in the provisional direction is V18_ACCEPTED morphology; the opposite raw turn is V18_REJECTED morphology. Neither is an economic outcome.
event_identity.no_future_label: Direction is fixed at onset. A later raw turn, price move, terminal state, MFE, MAE, return, or PnL may never back-label the onset.

phase_projection.ordered_front: First-alignment times must be nondecreasing from 30 through 480 minutes; equal timestamps are lawful ties. Missing horizons remain explicit and cannot be inferred.
phase_projection.fast_ownership: The 30-minute velocity must remain direction-aligned until the first 30-minute slope cross. If it turns opposite first, the candidate has failed fast ownership.
phase_projection.recoil: After the 30-minute slope cross, a temporary opposite 30-minute velocity is recorded as recoil. It is survived only if direction-aligned 30-minute velocity returns while the 30-minute slope and any higher Stage-114 authority remain unchanged.
phase_projection.no_magnitude_score: No slope, velocity, ATR, volume, quote, or flow magnitude is fitted or summed. Only exact sign, order, breadth, owner identity, and causal timing are recorded.

categorical_morphology.FAILED_FAST_OWNERSHIP: The 30-minute velocity loses the provisional direction before the 30-minute slope first aligns.
categorical_morphology.FAST_CROSS_ONLY: The 30-minute slope aligns while fast ownership remains intact, but no slower slope aligns before terminal.
categorical_morphology.PARTIAL_ORDERED_CASCADE: At least two slope horizons align and their first-alignment times are nondecreasing, but not all five align before terminal.
categorical_morphology.PARTIAL_DISORDERED_CASCADE: At least two slopes align but first-alignment order violates the short-to-long partial order.
categorical_morphology.FULL_PHASE_LOCK: All five slopes and all five velocities are direction-aligned on one finalized bar before terminal.
categorical_morphology.RECOIL_SURVIVED: A fast slope cross occurs, the 30-minute velocity recoils, and fast velocity reacquires while the 30-minute slope and authority owner remain direction-aligned.
categorical_morphology.RECOIL_FAILED: After a fast slope cross, the 30-minute slope or higher authority owner reverses before fast velocity reacquires.
categorical_morphology.UNDERWARM_OR_GAP: A required finalized horizon, prior velocity sign, source identity, or contract-contiguous clock is unavailable.

categorical_precedence: Any missing required identity or clock is UNDERWARM_OR_GAP.
Loss of fast ownership before the first fast slope cross is FAILED_FAST_OWNERSHIP.
After a fast slope cross, an authority or fast-slope reversal before velocity reacquisition is RECOIL_FAILED.
After a fast slope cross, successful velocity reacquisition is RECOIL_SURVIVED.
All five slopes and velocities aligned together is FULL_PHASE_LOCK.
Two or more slope crosses in nondecreasing horizon order is PARTIAL_ORDERED_CASCADE; an order violation is PARTIAL_DISORDERED_CASCADE.
Every remaining fast slope cross is FAST_CROSS_ONLY.
